Infrastructure repair 18 Aug - publish.py was failing silently. It set git user.email/user.name only inside the 'no .git directory' branch, but the standard restore path is now a fresh clone, which has a .git directory and no local identity. On a container with no global git config, 'git commit' therefore aborted with 'Author identity unknown', publish.py only inspected the output for the string 'nothing to commit', and the subsequent no-op push still printed the success message. Result: the durability layer reported success whilst committing nothing, which is very likely how the 30 Jul - 17 Aug outage went unnoticed. Fixed by setting the identity on every run and by raising on any commit failure other than an empty diff. Verified: local HEAD 865c3e7 now matches origin/main. Infrastructure repair only - no strategy code or parameters touched.
